fact: Basile Boli's header made Marseille the first French club to win the European Cup, in the first final played under the Champions League name.
Fabio Capello's Milan thrashed Johan Cruyff's Barcelona 'Dream Team', even without their suspended defenders Franco Baresi and Alessandro Costacurta.
Patrick Kluivert, an 18-year-old substitute, scored the winner five minutes from time for Louis van Gaal's young Ajax side.
Fabrizio Ravanelli put Juventus ahead and Jari Litmanen equalised for Ajax, before Juventus won the shootout in their own country.
Substitute Lars Ricken lobbed the goalkeeper with his first touch, seconds after coming on, to seal Borussia Dortmund's first European Cup.
Predrag Mijatović's goal won Real Madrid their seventh European Cup and ended a 32-year wait since their sixth in 1966.
Losing 1–0 going into stoppage time, Manchester United scored through Teddy Sheringham and Ole Gunnar Solskjær to complete the Treble.
The first European Cup final between two clubs from the same country. Fernando Morientes, Steve McManaman and Raúl scored.
Every goal in the match came from the penalty spot, and goalkeeper Oliver Kahn was the shootout hero as Bayern won their first European Cup since 1976.
Zinedine Zidane won it with a left-footed volley just before half-time, one of the most famous goals ever scored in a final.
The first all-Italian final ended goalless, and Andriy Shevchenko scored the winning penalty in the shootout.
José Mourinho's Porto won with goals from Carlos Alberto, Deco and Dmitri Alenichev. Mourinho left to coach Chelsea a few days later.
The 'Miracle of Istanbul': 3–0 down at half-time, Liverpool scored three goals in six minutes, then Jerzy Dudek saved Andriy Shevchenko's penalty to win the shootout.
Jens Lehmann became the first player sent off in a European Cup final, yet ten-man Arsenal led until late goals from Samuel Eto'o and Juliano Belletti.
A rematch of the 2005 final. Filippo Inzaghi scored both of Milan's goals to get revenge for Istanbul.
In the first all-English final, John Terry slipped taking a penalty that would have won it for Chelsea, and Edwin van der Sar saved from Nicolas Anelka.
In Pep Guardiola's first season as coach, Samuel Eto'o and a rare Lionel Messi header won the final and completed the first Treble by a Spanish club.
Diego Milito scored both goals as José Mourinho's Inter became the first Italian club to win the Treble.
Pedro, Lionel Messi and David Villa scored as Barcelona beat Manchester United in the final for the second time in three seasons.
Bayern played the final in their own stadium, but Didier Drogba headed a late equaliser and scored the winning penalty to give Chelsea their first European Cup.
In the first all-German final, Arjen Robben scored the winner in the 89th minute, a year after Bayern's home final defeat to Chelsea.
Sergio Ramos equalised in stoppage time, and Real Madrid scored three more in extra time to win 'La Décima', their tenth European Cup.
Ivan Rakitić, Luis Suárez and Neymar scored, making Barcelona the first club to win the Treble twice.
A rerun of the 2014 final went to penalties, and Cristiano Ronaldo scored the winning kick in Zinedine Zidane's first season as coach.
Cristiano Ronaldo scored twice as Real Madrid became the first club to retain the trophy in the Champions League era.
Substitute Gareth Bale scored a stunning overhead kick and then a second goal as Real Madrid won their third final in a row.
Mohamed Salah scored a penalty in the second minute and Divock Origi added a late second to win Liverpool's sixth European Cup.
Played behind closed doors during the Covid-19 pandemic. Kingsley Coman, a product of PSG's academy, headed the winner as Bayern won all 11 of their matches.
Kai Havertz scored the only goal as Chelsea won their second European Cup, a few months after Thomas Tuchel replaced Frank Lampard as coach.
Vinícius Júnior scored the winner and goalkeeper Thibaut Courtois made a string of saves. The final had been moved to Paris from Saint Petersburg.
Rodri's second-half goal won Manchester City their first European Cup and completed a Treble under Pep Guardiola.
Dani Carvajal and Vinícius Júnior scored in the last 20 minutes to win Real Madrid's record-extending 15th European Cup.
The biggest winning margin in a European Cup final. Désiré Doué scored twice as Paris Saint-Germain won their first title, under coach Luis Enrique.
